sessions.phase_label: Proposal review and campaign buildout planning

requirements.title: Advertising Account Review
requirements.definition: Review the client's new advertising account and identify relevant setup or planning considerations.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers account-level review only; examination of the drafted campaign and website are separately assessable review obligations.

requirements.title: Draft Campaign Audit
requirements.definition: Audit the unlaunched campaign drafted by the client and assess its proposed setup.
requirements.boundary_note: The drafted campaign is a concrete audit target distinct from general account-level settings and website review.

requirements.title: Website Review for PPC Readiness
requirements.definition: Review the client's website as an input to the PPC assessment and recommended campaign plan.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers evaluation of the website for campaign planning, not implementation of unrelated website layout fixes.

requirements.title: Campaign Buildout Proposal
requirements.definition: Provide a proposed plan for building the PPC campaign and scaling its results.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the recommended buildout plan; the client's specific request to assess forecast reliability and scaling potential is independently answerable.

requirements.title: Campaign Feasibility and Scaling Assessment
requirements.definition: Assess plausible lead volume, conversion performance, forecast reliability, and the potential to scale campaign spend beyond the initial level.
requirements.boundary_note: Treats feasibility and scalability as one tightly coupled analytical obligation; campaign targeting and budget settings remain separate configuration constraints.

requirements.title: Estate Planning Service Targeting
requirements.definition: Focus campaign targeting on people seeking estate planning services rather than other estate-law services such as probate, estate administration, or elder law.
requirements.boundary_note: Service-intent targeting can be changed independently from geographic targeting and campaign budget.

requirements.title: Campaign Geographic Targeting
requirements.definition: Target the campaign across New Jersey and affluent suburban counties near Philadelphia.
requirements.boundary_note: Geographic coverage is independently configurable and should not be collapsed into the service-intent targeting rule.

requirements.title: Initial Monthly Advertising Budget
requirements.definition: Begin campaign testing with an advertising budget of $2,000 per month.
requirements.boundary_note: The $2,000 amount is a temporary initial testing constraint; assessing whether later scaling is viable belongs to the scaling-assessment Requirement.

requirements.title: Seven-Hour Campaign Buildout
requirements.definition: Undertake the proposed seven-hour engagement to build out the PPC campaign.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the implementation engagement accepted after proposal review, distinct from producing the preceding audit and proposal.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client mentions a wide-screen layout issue but states that they will fix it themselves; available evidence does not establish it as a freelancer-owned website implementation Requirement.
